names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 1 martie, «Sfântul Mucenic Marcel».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Μάρκελλος και Αντώνιος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 1 марта ст. ст., name page 1472, «Маркелл, мч.», with the rank word left off. The line itself declines the name. The calendar gives him no surname, no toponymic and no epithet on either the line or the link, so the stored form is the bare forename. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports the form held by one other folder, `marcellus-15-november`, and the fold is read in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs`.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 марта ст. ст. — «Мчч. Маркелла и Антония .»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 1 martie — «Sfântul Mucenic Marcel»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Μάρκελλος και Αντώνιος»

attestations.note: One page holds the two of them and gives them one sentence: «Οι Άγιοι Μάρκελλος και Αντώνιος μαρτύρησαν αφού τους έριξαν μέσα στη φωτιά» — they were martyred after being thrown into the fire. It prints the distich «Χώνη τις ἡ κάμινος Ἀθληταῖς δύο, / Οἳ χρυσίου λάμπουσιν ἐν ταύτῃ πλέον», and gives no year, no country, no judge, no relic and no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
